class TwoSlotStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    RSI_EXIT_THRESHOLD = 70.0

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if self.spy in data.Bars else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if self.aapl in data.Bars else None

        if spy_bar is not None:
            spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)

            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                current_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
            else:
                current_spy_sma = None

            spy_crosses_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and current_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > current_spy_sma
            )

            spy_crosses_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and current_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < current_spy_sma
            )

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            if current_spy_sma is not None:
                self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
        else:
            spy_crosses_above = False
            spy_crosses_below = False

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
            aapl_red_for_three_days = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            aapl_rsi_above_threshold = (
                self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                and float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > self.RSI_EXIT_THRESHOLD
            )
        else:
            aapl_red_for_three_days = False
            aapl_rsi_above_threshold = False

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in (
            self.spy,
            self.aapl,
            self.ibm,
            self.bac,
            self.aig
        )):
            return

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi_above_threshold:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            target_value = float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40
            quantity = floor(target_value / float(spy_bar.Close))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and aapl_red_for_three_days:
            available_cash = float(self.Portfolio.Cash)
            purchase_amount = 20_000.0

            if available_cash >= purchase_amount:
                quantity = floor(purchase_amount / float(aapl_bar.Close))

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = data.Bars

        has_spy = bars.ContainsKey(self.spy)
        has_aapl = bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl)

        if has_aapl:
            aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        current_spy_close = None
        current_spy_sma = None

        if has_spy:
            current_spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close

            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        all_bars_present = all(
            bars.ContainsKey(symbol)
            for symbol in self.subscribed_symbols
        )

        if (
            not self.IsWarmingUp
            and all_bars_present
            and current_spy_close is not None
            and current_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
        ):
            spy_crossed_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and current_spy_close > current_spy_sma
            )

            spy_crossed_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and current_spy_close < current_spy_sma
            )

            aapl_rsi_above_threshold = (
                self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > self.RSI_THRESHOLD
            )

            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi_above_threshold:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
                target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
                quantity = math.floor(target_value / current_spy_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                    aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close
                    quantity = math.floor(20000 / aapl_close)

                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if has_spy:
            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
